test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48796ea66c2186be8571310c29085920aa6de27b3d140e33c710d24666407d08.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

1st column elements interchange positions.

2nd column elements shift to the 3rd column.

3rd column elements shift to the 3rd column diagonally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b42805bd9990dcf64cf3cdfd2cba47f47bfa1a110fb38e691da53199f279503.png] 

2) Second box series →

Left bottom corner elements is replaced by new element.

2nd column elements shift to the 3rd column.

First element of the 3rd column shift to the 2nd column.

1st row element shift to the bottom center position.

Second element of 3rd column shift to the opposite side diagonally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/127e91c77c723a0737eb97700792eb646b2601944b93b8dcb078d8820beffece.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15ee282e8b83dcc14686c003e85a3aee7357dd781859c59e0fd2d9cb24e92655.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
